name: pitchtribe-website
description: PitchTribe landing page — open-source Raspberry Pi 5 digital signage for clubs. Deployed to Cloudflare Pages.

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run copy && npm run build:css
scripts.preview: npm run build && wrangler pages dev dist
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=pitchtribe-website --branch=main
